title: Feature intake handshake and SLA onramp for hosted chat+tool integrations
creator: Aisha Kumar
description:
Goal: Build a predictable, audit-ready intake and prioritization flow (a 'handshake' + onramp) for enterprise customers requesting hosted chat features that include streaming, function/tool calling, and structured outputs. This ticket defines the decision criteria, required artifacts, and automated classifier signals to gate requests into SLA/rollout lanes (self-serve, sales-assisted, or dedicated).

Scope: Define eligibility rules, required documents, onboarding steps for each lane, telemetry hooks for readiness, and a minimum viable intake form to pilot with 3 enterprise customers. Work spans PM (process + acceptance), Design (form UX + monitoring dashboard mockups), and Engineering (classifier + routing + onboarding checklist automation).

Key acceptance criteria: 
- A documented decision tree that classifies incoming hosted chat/tool requests into one of three lanes: Self-serve (no SLA), Sales-assisted (SLA negotiation), Private/Dedicated (legal/compliance review).
- Intake form v1 (Confluence + Drive template) capturing: tenant size, PII classification, expected throughput (rps), latency SLO requested, model fidelity constraints, streaming/tool call chains, structured-output schema examples, and CI/CD rollback contacts.
- An automate-able priority score mapping (0-100) derived from signals (revenue, security sensitivity, latency requirement, audit requirement).
- Prototype request classifier in the intake API that returns lane recommendation and required next steps.
- A monitoring dashboard showing intake volume, lane conversion rates, mean time to onboard, and blocked reason buckets.

Non-goals: Replacing the full onboarding concierge; implementing Dedicated capacity provisioning; full legal contract automation.
acceptance_criteria: Decision tree doc published to Confluence and linked in intake form
Intake form v1 created and shareable (Drive template)
Automated priority score prototype that runs on sample dataset (unit tests + sample cases)
Dashboard panels for intake KPIs in Grafana/Looker with initial synthetic data
Sign-off from Security, Sales Engineering, and Runtime Reliability
comments: 2025-02-10 - Aisha Kumar: Kickoff notes: prioritize enterprise requests that involve streaming tool-chains and structured outputs because they have the highest ops friction and legal surface area.
2025-02-11 - Marco Chen: Reached out to Sales Eng for two pilot customers; they confirmed need for structured-output contract examples and a sample fallback policy for degraded performance.
2025-02-12 - Design (Leah Ortiz): Drafted form v1 wireframe; proposes progressive disclosure for PII and compliance fields to reduce friction.
2025-02-13 - Security (Ravi Patel): Preliminary review: require KMS/HSM commitment for any tenant requesting private data retention; recommended flag in intake form.

2025-02-14 - Eng (Priya Nair): Prototype classifier implemented as a serverless Lambda that scores requests by revenue proxy (tier), throughput, and security flags. Initial accuracy on hand-labeled set: 82%.

2025-02-15 - PM (Aisha): Decision: Pilot with two lanes first (Self-serve and Sales-assisted). Reserve Dedicated/DPM gating until we have a contractual checklist and provision playbook. Follow-up: create 'legal-ready' checklist linked as part of Sales-assisted output.
rollout_plan: Week 1: finalize decision tree and form v1. Week 2: implement prototype classifier + unit tests; wire up sample Grafana dashboard with synthetic data. Week 3: onboard 2 pilot customers with Sales Eng; collect feedback. Week 4: iterate on form fields and classifier thresholds, prepare brief for Security and Legal for Dedicated gating.
implementation_notes: Use existing intake API endpoint as a base (ops-intake) and add a new 'enterprise_recommendation' output field.
Classifier should be deterministic and explainable: output primary signals used and a short rationale string for transparency to Sales Eng.
Design to produce form components compatible with Console embedding and email-based intake fallback.
Telemetry: emit structured events for each submission with tags: lane_recommended, security_flags, estimated_rps, expected_slo_ms.
Runtime PR to consider: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtimes/pull/1245 (fallback routing hooks)
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Overly strict gate will delay customers and push them to competitors. Mitigation: progressive disclosure and default to Sales-assisted for ambiguous cases.
Risk: Under-scoring sensitive workloads (PII) could expose compliance. Mitigation: require explicit PII flags and security sign-off for lanes touching sensitive data.
Risk: Classifier false positives/negatives. Mitigation: log human review outcomes during pilot and retrain thresholds; add manual override workflow for Sales Eng.
next_steps: Design deliverables: intake form v1 mockup and Console embed examples (Leah) by 2025-02-18
Engineering: land prototype classifier and integrate with ops-intake API (Priya) by 2025-02-21
Schedule pilot onboarding sessions with Sales Eng for two customers (Marco) by 2025-02-19
